name: Chocolate Chip Cookies
description: The classic: crisp edges, chewy middles and plenty of chocolate.
instructions: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C) and line baking sheets with parchment.
Whisk the flour, baking soda and salt in a bowl.
Beat the butter and both sugars until light and creamy, about 2 minutes. Beat in the vanilla, then the eggs one at a time.
Mix in the flour mixture on low speed until just combined, then stir in the chocolate chips.
Drop rounded tablespoons of dough about 2 inches (5 cm) apart on the baking sheets.

instructions.text: Bake until the edges are golden and the centers still look a little soft, 9–11 minutes. Cool on the sheet for 2 minutes, then move to a rack.

tips: Chill the dough for at least 30 minutes (or up to 3 days) for thicker cookies with a deeper, toffee-like flavor.
Freeze scooped dough balls, then bake straight from frozen whenever you want a few cookies; add 1–2 minutes.
A sprinkle of flaky salt on top before baking makes them taste even better.
